tasks.instruction: Find out who wrote The Remains of the Day.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the search field, Enter and the result links all work with the keyboard; the filter chips are not needed

tasks.instruction: Add one Moss Path candle to the cart, then open the cart.

expected.keyboard-only: success: Add to cart works with Enter, although its focus outline is hidden

tasks.instruction: Report a pothole on Mill Lane, as Sara Khan. Send the form once without an email address; when it is not accepted, add sara@example.com and send it again.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the rejected form keeps the entered values and every field and the submit button are keyboard reachable; the error is shown only as a red border, so the agent must notice that the page did not change

tasks.instruction: Find out on which days of the week Dr Ahmed sees patients.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the doctors' days are text on the home page
